counts.timing_design: One randomized counterbalanced regime per task, two independently seeded repeated worlds; 72 primary tasks per regime
counts.reason: Pre-TEST financial/power revision: preserve all 216 primary tasks and repeated policies under the explicit $18 cap; full second-model core is financially infeasible. Full cross-deadline mechanism identification uses the separate 288 executed controlled branches. Small-effect and model-general claims are downgraded.

larger.serving_stack: Managed SGLang with native qwen3_coder tools and DFLASH
larger.scope: Fixed 36-task supplementary comparison; not full second-model replication

authoring_metadata_override: Frozen qualification evidence supersedes draft markers and original oracle_impl_ref; contract bytes remain immutable
additional_model_gate: All fixed DEV native and external DEV assignments terminal before any TEST inference; no efficacy threshold
native_history: Full continuous assistant/tool conversation; immutable initial definitions and dynamic batch results
primary_estimand: Source-weighted paired P3-P2 joint safe task completion
infrastructure_policy: Preserve every original failure; resume only unstarted assignments in new finite jobs. No post-TEST prompt, task, oracle, timing or enrollment tuning.
source_certificate_policy: Before any model call, hash complete quiescent DB/client/public/schedule cut; reject mismatched siblings before inference. Exact mid-trajectory reconstruction is not claimed.
unknown_policy: Missing, censored and invalid assignments remain UNKNOWN with full-denominator bounds; never silently dropped or converted to safe completion
shared_design_limit: Constructed 24 structural layouts and six business-policy vocabularies; inference is conditional on these operators
